In this video, we will begin to explore
the different areas
of the Altium Designer environment.
Once the project is open,

locate the Projects panel
to the left of the window
and double-click on the file.

This will open the schematic sheet
within the active workspace

and provide the working
view of the schematic.

Now double-click
the PCB document to open it.

This will open the PCB document
within the active workspace
and provide the working view of the PCB.
Altium Designer is a unified environment,
meaning that any type of design file,

including the schematics
and the PCB,

are accessed inside this
single environment.
With both documents open,

you will now notice tabs
in the document bar
located at the top of the design space.

Click on each of these tabs
and observe the workspace change
to match the selected document.

You can also use the keyboard shortcuts
‘Ctrl + Tab’ or ‘Ctrl + Shift + Tab’
to cycle between the open documents.

If we open multiple documents to the point
where the tabs fill up the entire bar,
they will be grouped.

We can also configure
this grouping method.

Click the preferences icon
in the upper right corner.

Expand the System branch
and select View.
Within the Documents Bar setting,

you can enable the
Group documents if need checkbox
and set it to By document kind.

Click OK to close
the Preferences window.
In this video,

the different areas of the Altium Designer
environment were explored.

title: Altium Training - Design Environment: The Altium Environment
